scope: Safer exit, sleep mode after updates, and clearer Radio prompts.

topics.title: Use Status while the microphone retries
details: If the update microphone is busy, the window stays open. Press Status or Enter to hear progress.

topics.title: Exit without the setup warning
details: An audio player or microphone that has already closed no longer stops the app from exiting. The full goodbye message still plays.

topics.title: Sleep mode after an update
details: After an update, Companion waits in sleep mode. Say "Wake up" or use the keyboard when you are ready. It no longer turns voice commands on by default.

topics.title: Clearer Radio prompts
details: The first Escape from station results says "Station actions." The next says "Radio menu." The menus work the same way as before.

topics.title: The update window keeps trying
details: A brief error while opening the microphone no longer closes the update window. The app tries again so you can use voice commands once the device is ready.

topics.title: Spoken favorite names
details: A period added by speech no longer gets in the way of opening a favorite. Your saved names stay the same.
